bagPolicy.summary: At Bills games, one clear bag up to 12" x 6" x 12" or one clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5" is allowed, plus a one gallon clear freezer bag.
allowed: One clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12" x 6" x 12"
Or one clutch up to 4.5" x 6.5"
One gallon clear plastic freezer bag
Diaper bags when accompanied by a child
prohibited: Non-clear bags larger than a clutch
bagPolicy.note: This is the Buffalo Bills policy for the new Highmark Stadium, which opened for the 2026 season. All bags are inspected and staff cannot hold items. Concert rules may differ, so check the event page.

parking.note: Convenient parking is available at Highmark Stadium NY, ensuring easy access for visitors. However, specific parking options and pricing details are not provided.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Highmark Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Highmark Stadium NY offers a wide variety of food and beverage options designed to enhance the fan experience. With modern amenities and a focus on guest satisfaction, visitors can enjoy diverse culinary choices during events.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Designated accessible parking for guests with disabilities is available in Blue Lot ADA or White Lot ADA. Accessible Seating platforms provide space for There is no storage for wheelchairs or mobility devices anywhere inside the stadium.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry to the stadium using the same ticket is prohibited. For emergencies, visit a Guest Experience Booth or Gate Supervisor before leaving. Re-entry within the secure perimeter requires another security check.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: For Bills games, the ticket resolution windows are at the Bills Box Office Powered by Ticketmaster next to Entry 8, open from three hours before kickoff to the end of the first half. Will call requires photo ID, tickets go only to the account holder, and will call drop-off is not allowed. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For Bills games, security gates open three hours before kickoff, and all guests are screened when entering the secure perimeter. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.
